question.text: If Rani has 30 years to save (instead of 25) for the same target retirement corpus at a 12% return, her required monthly savings is approximately:

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook page 78 supports that with 30 years (360 months) to save for the same corpus at 12%, the required monthly saving works out to approximately Rs.8,512. The extra years of compounding meaningfully reduce the monthly contribution. The Trap: A separate workbook example on the same page covers postponing retirement age (which changes income/corpus assumptions and yields a different figure of about Rs.8,934 over 30 years); the two examples should not be conflated. Note: The Rs.8,512 figure is specifically for the same-corpus, 30-years-to-save scenario.
